title: Issues in Racialization, Ethnicity and Decolonization
description: In-depth examination of contemporary issues related to the sociology of racialization, ethnicity, and decolonization. Topics may include: racialization and racism, ethnicity and ethnocentrism, European colonialism, normalization of whiteness, domination, cultural imperialism, gender and racialization, gendered aspects of colonization, settler colonialism, decolonization, liberation.

items.text: declared Honours or Major in Sociology

recommendations: SOCI 103, SOCI 235, and SOCI 384 are recommended prior to SOCI 430A.
